instruction: A medium eye-level photograph captures a quiet, affectionate moment outdoors against a red brick wall. On the left, the curly-haired woman (R1) in a white ruffled dress stands holding hands with the woman in the white blazer (R2) on the right. R2 leans in, resting her head gently on R1's shoulder with her eyes closed in a peaceful expression. Both women wear serene smiles, sharing a quiet bond. The scene is bathed in soft, natural daylight, creating a warm and romantic atmosphere.
